results.name: Tutor inbox searches rooms and sends a family message visible to student and parent
Student reply appears on their right and reaches both other participants
Parent can chat in the same room with a distinct role and shared read receipts
Message edit and removal propagate through polling while preserving a removed-message marker
Parent image attachments upload privately and both tutor and student can preview in place
Unread family-chat badge appears outside the room and clears after opening it
Tutor and family chat layouts fit a phone; tutor can return to room list
